    U

    UcumEssence - Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    The unmodified UCUM file, read as it is: its prefixes, its base units, and its defined units, every code, name, symbol, property, class, and definition as the file writes them.
    UcumEssence.BaseUnit - Record Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    One base unit as the file writes it.
    UcumEssence.Function - Record Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    The function a special unit is defined by.
    UcumEssence.Prefix - Record Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    One prefix as the file writes it.
    UcumEssence.Unit - Record Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    One defined unit as the file writes it.
    UcumGrammar - Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    UCUM's grammar for unit codes, as the specification gives it: a term is components joined by a period for a product or a solidus for a quotient, and may open with a solidus; a component is a unit with an optional exponent, a number, a parenthesized term, or an annotation in braces; a unit is an atom, or a prefix on a metric atom.
    UcumIdentity - Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    Where every UCUM component gets its identity (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1114): derived, never random, from what the component is.
    UcumImporter - Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    Reads the unmodified UCUM file into the store as knowledge (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1114): a concept for each property, each base unit and defined unit under its property, and each prefix, every code, name, symbol, class, and definition kept verbatim in the concept's record, IKE's reduction to the base units beside them marked as IKE's, and the four relations that say UCUM's second, minute, hour, and millisecond are IKE's own units of that name.
    UcumImporter(StampCalculator) - Constructor for class network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum.UcumImporter
    Creates an importer over a view.
    UcumImporter.Report - Record Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    What an import did.
    UcumReduction - Record Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    A unit reduced to UCUM's seven base units: an exponent on each base dimension and a magnitude in the base units, computed by IKE from UCUM's definitions (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1114).
    UcumReduction(List, BigDecimal, boolean, boolean) - Constructor for record class network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum.UcumReduction
    Checks the shape and normalizes the magnitude.
    UcumSymbols - Interface in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    What the grammar and the reduction need to know about UCUM's atoms and prefixes: which codes exist, which atoms take a prefix, what each atom reduces to, and what each prefix multiplies by.
    UcumSyntaxException - Exception Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    A unit code the grammar cannot read, refused with its place: the code, the position of the first character that could not be read, counted from zero, and what was expected there.
    UcumSyntaxException(String, int, String) - Constructor for exception class network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum.UcumSyntaxException
    Creates the refusal.
    UcumTerm - Record Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    A unit code read by UCUM's grammar: a number, the factors it multiplies, each a prefix if any, an atom, and an exponent, and the annotations in braces, which mean nothing to the algebra and are kept outside it (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1114).
    UcumTerm(String, BigDecimal, List, List) - Constructor for record class network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum.UcumTerm
    Keeps the lists immutable.
    UcumTerm.Factor - Record Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    One factor of a unit: a prefix, empty when none, an atom, and an exponent.
    UcumUnits - Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum
    The UCUM units as the store holds them after import: the atoms and prefixes read back from their records, so that a unit code met later, in a library's quantity, is read by the grammar against the knowledge in the graph, and a composed unit is made on demand, once, identified by its canonical code.
